strs.description: Binary serialized array of strings representing the actual content of the numpy array

lengths.description: Binary serialized array of ints indicating where the bytes array must be spliced to recover the original values

title:
Type containing logic for the binary serialization of a numpy array of strings. Custom serialization must be used
to ensure the serialization has no version dependency on numpy. The bytes binary contains the actual array content
and is spliced at each location indicated by the lengths binary to recover the original values
